details.analysis_scope: Static manifest and standard classes*.dex string pools/method instructions; local constants plus single initializer field writes and one-hop static crypto wrappers within each DEX. Field-derived findings are possible static indicators, not proof of runtime immutability. No native code, dynamically loaded code, whole-program data flow, exploit or runtime verification.
